capabilities: Open .xmind files from the file list in a mind map view
Add, delete, rename, and collapse nodes interactively
Create new mind maps via command palette or file-list context menu
Export maps as SVG or PNG
Configure autosave interval, default layout, branch colors, and minimap
extras: README is mostly in Chinese with a partial English translation. The manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. The bundled fflate library (MIT) handles .xmind ZIP parsing.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to open or edit .xmind mind map files, so users must leave the app to work with them.
summary: Mind map viewer and editor that opens and interactively edits XMind (.xmind) files inside Obsidian on desktop and mobile.
